summary: Frontend-only test of the new Fascicolo tecnico (Allegati A/B/C) on mobile 390px, using a temporary Firebase user that is now deleted. FORM: Tipo chiusura has 6 options including 'Tapparella motorizzata'. Section 3c (fascicolo-details) is closed by default. All fields save to the DB and are still there after reopening: cliente tel/cf, ch-produttore/anno/matricola/ante/peso, pratica-ch-ce, au-produttore/modello/matricola, au-alim, in_vista, intervento, modifiche, mod-sost, consegna 9 Si/No. 'Chiusura in vista' shows only with impulsivo. Modifiche and modifica sostanziale show only with 'esistente'. 'Segna tutto Sì' works. The brand datalist (9 brands) is attached to au-produttore and to every 3b component marca. PDF: 17 PDFs downloaded with 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors: tapparella fascicolo/CE/registro/full, fascicolo 2027, full PDF for the other 5 tipi, blank fascicolo for 2 regimi x 2 tipi, blank full tapparella 2027, and a legacy pratica without the new fields. 'Pagina X di 5' is consistent on all fascicolo pages, also when embedded in the 19-page full PDF. No backslashes and no 'Trcinamento'. The '________' only appears in the blank fascicolo number. The 6 COMPANY lines are on every header (Flow, CE, registro) with no overlap. Regime switches correctly: 2006/42/CE for 2026 dates, Reg. UE 2023/1230 for 2027. Tapparella uses UNI EN 13659 in the fascicolo and in the CE 'Norma di riferimento'. B.1 ticks the right row and gruppo: impulsivo+non in vista+condominiale gives the nonvista row and G2; automatico+pubblico gives the automatico row and G3. The blank fascicolo has 0 crosses and no dates apart from normative ones. BUGS FOUND: (1) B.1 table header labels are not wrapped: they are clipped, and 'Gruppo 3 - Persone non informate, uso illimitato' runs past the right page margin. (2) B.3 prints the old modifiche crosses and 'modifica sostanziale [X] Sì' even when intervento is switched back to 'Nuova installazione' (the UI hides them, the PDF doesn't). (3) Section 5 'Riferimenti normativi' doesn't fit on page 1: page 2 holds only section 5, so the fascicolo is 5 pages instead of 4, with page 1 holding sections 1-4. (4) The tapparella CE still says 'attestata secondo la norma EN 13241', 'UNI EN 13241 Conforme' and '1. Serranda / Chiusura — UNI EN 13241', while 'Norma di riferimento' says UNI EN 13659.

ui_bugs.component: praticaPdf.js fascicolo() B.1 table / Flow.table header()
ui_bugs.issue: Header cells are drawn with doc.text without splitTextToSize. The group headers ('Gruppo N - Persone informate, area privata', ~170pt) don't fit the ~114pt columns, so they overlap the next column. 'Gruppo 3 ... uso illimitato' goes past the right page margin and is cut off. Fix: wrap the header text (variable header height) or use short headers like 'Gruppo 1' and put the description in a legend row.

The modifiche checks (mods.includes(k)) and sn(f.modifica_sostanziale) are not gated by f.intervento === 'esistente'. Reproduction: set esistente, tick motore+sicurezze, set mod-sost Sì, switch to 'Nuova installazione'. The PDF then shows Nuova installazione [X] together with 2 modifiche [X] and 'modifica sostanziale [X] Sì'. Fix: const esist = f.intervento === 'esistente'; use mods only if esist, and sn(esist ? f.modifica_sostanziale : '') (or clear modifiche/mod_sost in the UI when switching to nuovo).

With all documents included, the section 4 table (11 rows) fills page 1. Section 5 'Riferimenti normativi' then moves alone to page 2, which is about 25% used, '(segue)'. The request asked for a first page with sections 1-5. Fix: make section 4 more compact (2 columns of documents, or smaller row height / font 8), shorten the intro, or put section 5 next to 4.

For tipo tapparella, toCe sets norma_riferimento to 'UNI EN 13659', but the CE intro text still says 'secondo la norma EN 13241', the field 'UNI EN 13241: Conforme' remains, and NORME row 1 is 'Serranda / Chiusura — UNI EN 13241'. This is inconsistent for a tapparella. Also, the 'norma' and 'EN 13241' rich-text runs have no space between them ('normaEN 13241').

issues: In the Automatismo row, BrandInput uses a div label with different metrics than Field's <Label>, so 'Produttore' and 'Modello' sit about 7px out of line with each other.
The au-alimentazione choice (230 Vac / 24 Vdc / 400 Vac) has no 'Alimentazione' label above it.
The rows under the tables ('Dichiarazione CE / DoP...', 'Alimentazione:', 'Gruppo di utenza:') touch the bottom border of the table above. Add a gap of about 6pt.
B.1 mixes text '[X]' marks in the table with graphic boxes for Gruppo. Using a single style would look more consistent.
A legacy or impulsivo pratica with in_vista unset ticks no B.1 row. Consider defaulting to 'non in vista', the more conservative choice.

action_items: Wrap or shorten the B.1 table headers (Flow.table header has no text wrapping); Gruppo 3 runs past the page margin
In B.3, gate the modifiche checks and the modifica sostanziale value on intervento === 'esistente'
Fit sections 1-5 on page 1 of the fascicolo (compact the section 4 table)
Tapparella CE: replace the hardcoded EN 13241 in the intro, field and norme row with UNI EN 13659; fix the missing space 'normaEN'
Optional: align the BrandInput label with Field, add an 'Alimentazione' label, add a gap under the tables
critical_code_review_comments: BrandInput renders <datalist id='marche-automazioni'> once per input (16 duplicate ids in the DOM). Render it once in FascicoloSection or the dialog.
In fascicolo(), the def/comp logic for components duplicates componenti() (lines 662-666 vs 716-720). Extract a helper.
Flow.checks() never calls ensure(), so a long checks block can run past BOTTOM. Not hit today.
praticaPdf.js is 845 lines (over 700). Consider splitting it: fascicolo/targhetta/schema into modules.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (form, persistence, regimes, headers, page numbering, blank forms and 6-type regression pass; 2 HIGH and 2 MEDIUM PDF bugs)
